response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(cnt) AS avg_of_group_telescope_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g
